unit.finding: Under cfg(feature=client-proxy-system,target_os=macos), Builder::from_system invokes mac::with_system. The macOS helper obtains the SystemConfiguration proxy map and returns without mutation if it is unavailable. It only fills builder.http when that field is empty and only fills builder.https when that field is empty; each field is populated only when the corresponding enabled flag resolves to integer 1 and a proxy host is present. A present port is appended as host:port; a host without a port is accepted; a port without a host or a disabled/missing flag yields no value. The helper does not populate all, no, or is_cgi and does not overwrite environment-derived nonempty http/https values.
unit.phase1_relevance: This source-level boundary shows a deterministic local fallback merge from OS proxy configuration into the same in-process Builder state without an external hosted executor, and with environment settings taking precedence for the two populated fields. It is useful architectural evidence but not end-to-end parity evidence.
